_how_to_fill_this_in: Two classmates you pitched your project to in the lab, in the role 'stakeholder'. Not yourself; not the same two as next week.
student_id: their 9-digit student number (ask them; do not guess).

what: one sentence on what they actually said — a question they asked, a feature they wanted, an objection. It is the evidence that the conversation happened; two numbers with nothing behind them earn neither of you anything.
Weak: 'Gave feedback.'  Strong: 'Asked what happens if two students book the same slot at the same second — added to UC1 as what can go wrong.'
Better still: say what you changed because of it. You may delete this block once you have read it; the checker ignores it.
